title: Size of the pyramid at El Mirador

tellings.quote: for the last 5 minutes I was walking on the pyramid straight.

plain: The pyramid at El Mirador, an ancient ruined site in the jungle of Guatemala, is so big that you can walk on it for minutes without knowing, says a researcher named Luke Caverns. He went there in 2024 and tells Michels he realised that "for the last 5 minutes I was walking on the pyramid straight." He tells it to show how huge and overgrown these old buildings are.
